office_does: The Sheriff leads the Mason County Sheriff's Office, the county's law enforcement agency.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Ryan Spurling (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Mason County Sheriff since 2023, retired after 25 years with the Washington State Patrol; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Sheriff since 2023; 25 years with the State Patrol and more than 22 years of military service [S1]
Promises a transparent office that is responsible with tax dollars [S1]
Opposed the 2026 state law letting a state board remove sheriffs, parts of which a judge enjoined [S3]
